items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: How about your friend on Constant Street, the Italian man that was...

ctx.x: And Lawrence Vega. Lawrence Vega. Is he older than you or about the same age? Oh, he's older. Older man than you. He's dead, too. He was hot, too. Is he a good hot trumpet player that played ragtime? Oh, yeah.
How about your friend on Constant Street, the Italian man that was... Oh, yeah.
Oh, yeah. How did he play in the old days?
